name: FAGE BestSelf Lactose-Free Plain Greek Yogurt
whyItWorks: Authentic strained Greek yogurt treated with lactase enzyme so that it is 100% lactose-free while retaining 15g of concentrated milk protein and live active cultures. Extremely thick, smooth, and devoid of gums or artificial thickeners.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled. Stir in a teaspoon of pure maple syrup or seedless blueberry puree for gentle flavor.
